title: Rule-110 Glider Diagnostics
input: BT1864 120-step orbit on the BT1858 length-30 tape seed
glider_verdict: The finite ring orbit shows nontrivial domain-wall and diagonal persistence, but no isolated long-lived glider family is proven in the 30-cell periodic box. Best signatures are stationary persistence length 18 and diagonal persistence length 12 at velocities -3,-2,-1,+3.
hole_phase_result: The Z6 hole track cycles uniformly and remains active; it is a phase/gauge clock on top of the Rule-110 gap dynamics, not the source of the binary complexity itself.
boundary: Finite glider diagnostic on a length-30 periodic orbit; no universal Rule-110 glider catalogue or physical implementation proof is claimed.
